rounds.name: Strait of Gibraltar
rounds.fact: The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea and separates Europe from Africa.

rounds.name: Sinai Peninsula
rounds.fact: The triangular Sinai Peninsula serves as the land bridge between the continents of Asia and Africa.

rounds.name: Baja California
rounds.fact: The narrow Baja California peninsula separates the Pacific Ocean from the Gulf of California.

rounds.name: Cape of Good Hope
rounds.fact: The Cape of Good Hope marks the rocky headland on the Atlantic coast of South Africa navigated by early Portuguese explorers.

rounds.name: Cook Strait
rounds.fact: Cook Strait connects the Tasman Sea with the South Pacific Ocean between New Zealand’s North and South Islands.

rounds.name: Bosphorus Strait
rounds.fact: The Bosphorus Strait forms part of the continental boundary between Europe and Asia, dividing the historic city of Istanbul.

rounds.name: Cape Horn
rounds.fact: Cape Horn is the southernmost headland of the Tierra del Fuego archipelago, marking the northern boundary of the Drake Passage.

rounds.name: Korean Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Korean Peninsula extends southward from the Asian continent between the Sea of Japan and the Yellow Sea.

rounds.name: Strait of Malacca
rounds.fact: The Strait of Malacca is a narrow maritime stretch between the Malay Peninsula and the Indonesian island of Sumatra.

rounds.name: Florida Keys
rounds.fact: The Florida Keys are a coral cay archipelago extending southwest from the tip of the Florida peninsula.

rounds.name: Peloponnese Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Peloponnese peninsula in southern Greece is separated from the central mainland by the narrow Corinth Canal.

rounds.name: Yucatan Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Yucatan Peninsula separates the Gulf of Mexico from the Caribbean Sea and is composed predominantly of limestone.

rounds.name: Strait of Hormuz
rounds.fact: The Strait of Hormuz connects the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea.

rounds.name: Mozambique Channel
rounds.fact: The Mozambique Channel is an arm of the Indian Ocean located between the island of Madagascar and southeast Africa.

rounds.name: Tasmania
rounds.fact: Tasmania is an island state of Australia separated from the mainland by the rough waters of Bass Strait.

rounds.name: Kattegat Strait
rounds.fact: The Kattegat is a shallow sea area bounded by the Jutland peninsula in the west and Sweden in the east.

rounds.name: Kamchatka Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Kamchatka Peninsula lies in the Russian Far East between the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Okhotsk.

rounds.name: Isthmus of Panama
rounds.fact: The narrow Isthmus of Panama connects North and South America and is traversed by the Panama Canal.

rounds.name: Cape York Peninsula
rounds.fact: Cape York Peninsula is a large remote peninsula located in Far North Queensland, Australia.

rounds.name: Bab-el-Mandeb
rounds.fact: The Bab-el-Mandeb strait connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden between Yemen and Djibouti.

rounds.name: Dardanelles Strait
rounds.fact: The Dardanelles connects the Aegean Sea with the Sea of Marmara and has served as a strategic military choke point.

rounds.name: Vancouver Island
rounds.fact: Vancouver Island lies along Canada’s Pacific Coast, separated from the mainland by the Strait of Georgia.

rounds.name: Falkland Islands
rounds.fact: The Falkland Islands are an archipelago in the South Atlantic Ocean on the Patagonian Shelf.

rounds.name: Sri Lanka / Palk Strait
rounds.fact: The Palk Strait is a shallow water body between the Tamil Nadu state of India and the northern tip of Sri Lanka.

rounds.name: Gulf of Guinea Coast
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Guinea represents the northeasternmost part of the tropical Atlantic Ocean off western Africa.

rounds.name: Crimean Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Crimean Peninsula extends into the Black Sea and is connected to the mainland by the narrow Isthmus of Perekop.

rounds.name: Taiwan Strait
rounds.fact: The Taiwan Strait separates the island of Taiwan from the continental Asian mainland.

rounds.name: Great Australian Bight
rounds.fact: The Great Australian Bight is a vast open bay off the southern coastline of the Australian continent.

rounds.name: Newfoundland
rounds.fact: Newfoundland is a large island off the eastern coast of North America, blocking the mouth of the Saint Lawrence River.

rounds.name: Cape Agulhas
rounds.fact: Cape Agulhas is the true southernmost point of the African continent and the official dividing line between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans.

rounds.name: Corsica and Sardinia Strait
rounds.fact: The Strait of Bonifacio is the international strait separating the French island of Corsica from the Italian island of Sardinia.

rounds.name: Tsugaru Strait
rounds.fact: The Tsugaru Strait is a channel between Honshu and Hokkaido in northern Japan, traversed underground by the Seikan Tunnel.

rounds.name: Beagle Channel
rounds.fact: The Beagle Channel is a strait in the Tierra del Fuego archipelago on the extreme southern tip of South America.

rounds.name: Cape Canaveral
rounds.fact: Cape Canaveral is a prominent barrier island promontory on the Atlantic coast of Florida used for major space launches.

rounds.name: Gulf of Aden
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Aden is a deepwater gulf between the Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa.

rounds.name: Jutland Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Jutland peninsula comprises the continental mainland part of Denmark and northern Germany.

rounds.name: Gulf of Aqaba
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Aqaba is a northeastern arm of the Red Sea extending between the Sinai Peninsula and the Arabian Peninsula.

rounds.name: Gulf of California
rounds.fact: The Gulf of California is a marginal sea of the Pacific Ocean that separates the Baja California Peninsula from the Mexican mainland.

rounds.name: Cape Leeuwin
rounds.fact: Cape Leeuwin is the most south-westerly mainland point of the Australian continent.

rounds.name: Cape Verde Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Cap-Vert peninsula is the westernmost point of the African continent, upon which the city of Dakar is situated.

rounds.name: Skagerrak Strait
rounds.fact: The Skagerrak is a strait running between the southeast coast of Norway, the Bohuslän coast of Sweden and the Jutland peninsula of Denmark.

rounds.name: Strait of Magellan
rounds.fact: The Strait of Magellan is a navigable sea route in southern Chile separating mainland South America to the north and Tierra del Fuego to the south.

rounds.name: Torres Strait
rounds.fact: Torres Strait is a strait which lies between Australia and the Melanesian island of New Guinea.

rounds.name: Gulf of Oman
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Oman connects the Arabian Sea with the Strait of Hormuz, running along the coast of Oman, the UAE, and Iran.

rounds.name: Chesapeake Bay
rounds.fact: Chesapeake Bay is an estuary in the Mid-Atlantic region of the United States surrounded by Maryland and Virginia.

rounds.name: Brittany Peninsula
rounds.fact: Brittany is a rugged peninsula extending from western France into the Atlantic Ocean toward the Celtic Sea.

rounds.name: Gulf of Suez
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Suez is a gulf at the northern end of the Red Sea, leading into the southern terminus of the Suez Canal.

rounds.name: Aleutian Islands
rounds.fact: The volcanic Aleutian Islands extend westward from the Alaska Peninsula into the northern Pacific Ocean toward the Kamchatka Peninsula.

rounds.name: Korean Strait / Busan
rounds.fact: The Korea Strait is a sea passage between South Korea and Japan, connecting the East China Sea and the Sea of Japan.

rounds.name: Bass Strait
rounds.fact: Bass Strait is a strait separating the island state of Tasmania from the Australian mainland state of Victoria.

rounds.name: English Channel / Strait of Dover
rounds.fact: The Strait of Dover is the narrowest part of the English Channel, marking the boundary between the Channel and the North Sea.

rounds.name: Reykjanes Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Reykjanes peninsula in southwestern Iceland is characterized by active volcanism and extensive post-glacial lava fields.

rounds.name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
rounds.fact: The Andaman Islands form an archipelago in the northeastern Indian Ocean separating the Bay of Bengal from the Andaman Sea.

rounds.name: Puget Sound
rounds.fact: Puget Sound is a complex estuarine inlet along the northwestern coast of the U.S. state of Washington.

rounds.name: Stewart Island
rounds.fact: Stewart Island is the third-largest island of New Zealand, located south of the South Island across Foveaux Strait.

rounds.name: Gulf of Corinth
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Corinth is a deep inlet of the Ionian Sea that separates the Peloponnese from western mainland Greece.

rounds.name: Baffin Island Coast
rounds.fact: Baffin Island in the Canadian territory of Nunavut is the largest island in Canada and is bounded by Baffin Bay.

rounds.name: Gulf of Thailand
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Thailand is a shallow inlet in the southwestern South China Sea bounded by Cambodia, Thailand, and Vietnam.

rounds.name: Walvis Bay
rounds.fact: Walvis Bay is a coastal port on the Atlantic coast of Namibia sheltered by the Pelican Point sand spit.

rounds.name: North Island / Bay of Plenty
rounds.fact: The Bay of Plenty is a bight along the northern coast of New Zealand’s North Island renowned for geothermal activity.

rounds.name: Kola Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Kola Peninsula in northwestern Russia lies almost entirely north of the Arctic Circle between the Barents and White Seas.

rounds.name: Hokkaido / Nemuro Strait
rounds.fact: The Nemuro Strait is a channel separating the Japanese island of Hokkaido from the Kuril Islands.

rounds.name: Gulf of Saint Lawrence
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Saint Lawrence is the outlet of the North American Great Lakes via the Saint Lawrence River into the Atlantic Ocean.

rounds.name: Zanzibar Archipelago
rounds.fact: The Zanzibar Archipelago is a group of islands off the coast of East Africa in the Indian Ocean.

rounds.name: Gulf of Carpentaria
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Carpentaria is a large, shallow sea enclosed on three sides by northern Australia and bounded on the north by the Arafura Sea.

rounds.name: Tarifa / Punta de Tarifa
rounds.fact: Punta de Tarifa in Andalusia is the southernmost point of the Iberian Peninsula and of continental Europe.

rounds.name: Red Sea / Dahlak Archipelago
rounds.fact: The Dahlak Archipelago is an island group off the coast of Eritrea in the southern Red Sea known for marine pearl fisheries.

rounds.name: Galapagos Islands
rounds.fact: The Galapagos Islands are an isolated volcanic archipelago in the Pacific Ocean distributed on both sides of the equator.

rounds.name: Persian Gulf / Musandam
rounds.fact: The Musandam peninsula is an exclave of Oman projecting into the Strait of Hormuz characterized by dramatic fjord-like khors.

rounds.name: Whitsunday Islands
rounds.fact: The Whitsunday Islands are a collection of continental islands off the central coast of Queensland, Australia, bordered by the Great Barrier Reef.
